basic_details.job_title: RCB Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB), Faridabad, has invited online applications for one Project Technical Support-III position in the project "Mechanisms and Clinical Implications of Phenotypic Switching in Candida auris: Toward Targeted Antifungal Interventions", under Principal Investigator Dr. Anil Thakur, Associate Professor. The fellowship is Rs.28,000/- + 30% HRA per month, initially for one year. Applications must be submitted online by 30 November 2026, 05:00 PM, and the online interview is on 4 December 2026 from 10:30 AM onwards.

content_sections.heading: About RCB
content_sections.text: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology is located at 3rd Milestone, Faridabad-Gurgaon Expressway, NCR Biotech Science Cluster, Faridabad, Haryana. This position is in a project led by Dr. Anil Thakur, Associate Professor, on Candida auris. The notice is a project recruitment by RCB itself.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The experience requirement of at least three years of post-qualification experience is attached to the three-year graduate degree route. The postgraduate route is stated as "a postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline". Prior research experience specifically working with Candida species. At least one publication in a relevant field. The notice does not mention an age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject/field, such as Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, or Microbiology, with at least three years of post-qualification experience, or a postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs.28,000/- + 30% HRA per month. The engagement is initially for one year and may be extended based on annual evaluation, till the duration of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCB Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Applications are made online through the link "Click here to apply online" in the notice. The last date is 30 November 2026, 05:00 PM. The notice asks candidates to upload copies of the following documents: M.Sc. Degree Certificate Certificate of Experience For any query, candidates may contact the Principal Investigator by email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email by 2 December 2026 to appear in the online interview. The interview will be held at 10:30 AM onwards on 4 December 2026. The notice does not describe how candidates are shortlisted.
